features.summary: The ML test suite now checks that text generation stops when someone presses the chat’s stop button and that a model can be assigned to a device for generation. It also adds testing of llama.cpp, a tool for running language models, on the Metal GPU in macOS’s CI machines; the ESLint change is only a comment-related tooling update.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: about:inference fixes for HWInference engines.

features.summary: The about:inference page, a built-in view for inspecting machine-learning inference, is being expanded with device panels and controls for text generation. The changes also fix issues with hardware-accelerated inference engines and stop the page from reading an outdated device-pipeline option.

features.label: ML engine & pipelines

patches.author: Damien Carver
patches.subject: Replace prefix: with logModule: in the console.createInstance calls (Automatic fixes).

patches.author: Damien Carver
patches.subject: Rename the "ML:OpenAIPipeline" and "ML:LlamaCppPipeline" log modules to "GeckoMLOpenAIPipeline" and "GeckoMLLlamaCppPipeline".

patches.author: Fred Chasen
patches.subject: Add a widget-generation ML feature, service type and purpose

features.summary: Firefox’s machine-learning features now include a defined service for generating widgets. Logging labels for the OpenAI and llama.cpp pipelines were also renamed to make them easier to identify; these changes don’t introduce a visible interface change.

features.label: ML IPC

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: List the inference devices of the HWInference process.

features.summary: Firefox can now ask its hardware-inference process which devices are available for running machine-learning models. This gives other parts of the browser information they need to choose where inference should run.

features.label: ML actors

patches.author: Fred Chasen
patches.subject: Update EngineDispatcher to only be idle when nothing is running.

features.summary: The machine-learning engine dispatcher now reports itself as idle only when no work is running. This helps the browser avoid treating an active model operation as finished.

features.label: ML inference engine

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 4: Record the kind of device that loaded a text generation model.

features.summary: Firefox now records what kind of device loaded a text-generation model, such as a CPU or GPU. This makes it easier to understand which hardware is being used when a model runs.

features.label: Native text generation

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 2: Let a TextGenerator choose its device through a placement.

features.summary: Native text generation can now be assigned to a chosen device through a placement setting, rather than relying only on the default. This gives Firefox more control over where a model runs.

features.label: Page extractor

patches.author: MoHan Zhang
patches.subject: Keep the URLs of anchors around block content in extracted page text

features.summary: Extracted page text now retains the URLs of links near blocks of content. That means information taken from a page can keep useful links alongside the text.

features.label: Page extractor tests

patches.author: calixteman
patches.subject: Reject pending PDF text requests on actor destruction.

features.summary: Pending PDF text requests are now rejected if the page-extraction actor that handles them is destroyed. This prevents requests from being left unresolved when their handler goes away.

features.summary: The ML test suite now covers stopping text generation, choosing a device for a model, and running llama.cpp on macOS’s Metal GPU. It also adds checks for ONNX model memory use and cleanup after startup failures, model downloads using the Origin Private File System (OPFS), and Smart Window’s handling of exhausted service budgets; some tests that pass under ThreadSanitizer (a tool for finding concurrency problems) were re-enabled.

features.summary: Firefox’s ML pipelines now define a widget-generation feature, while their logging labels have been clarified. The changes also adjust how Smart Window handles authentication and how model-related data uses OPFS, the browser’s private site-storage area; a private-browsing check was corrected.

features.label: Page extractor

patches.author: MoHan Zhang
patches.subject: Keep the URLs of anchors around block content in extracted page text

patches.subject: Give monitor checks time to settle before reading pages

patches.subject: Allow Smart Window to read longer YouTube transcripts

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: clean up outcomes in PageExtractor phase telemetry

features.summary: Page extraction now keeps nearby link URLs, allows Smart Window to read longer YouTube transcripts, and waits for monitor checks to finish before reading pages. The related telemetry—the data used to track extraction outcomes—was also cleaned up.

features.label: about:inference page

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Stop reading the device pipeline option.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 3: Text generation panel in about:inference.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 2: Sub-tabs and a devices panel in about:inference.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: about:inference fixes for HWInference engines.

features.summary: The about:inference page, a built-in view for inspecting machine-learning inference, is being expanded with device panels and controls for text generation. The changes also fix issues with hardware-accelerated inference engines and stop the page from reading an outdated device-pipeline option.

features.label: ML actors

patches.author: Fred Chasen
patches.subject: Update EngineDispatcher to only be idle when nothing is running.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Release native ONNX inference outputs and metadata. Release engines and workers after initialization failure.

patches.author: Dão Gottwald
patches.subject: Correct the JSDoc types of getInferenceOptions, getAccuracyStats and computeRandScore.

features.summary: Machine-learning tasks are now reported as idle only when no work is running, and ONNX inference results and metadata, engines, and workers are released when no longer needed—including after initialization failures. This helps avoid lingering resources and makes it easier for Firefox to manage inference work reliably.

features.label: ML IPC

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: List the inference devices of the HWInference process.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Fix --disable-webspeech.

features.summary: The hardware inference process can now report which devices are available for machine-learning tasks, helping Firefox identify where inference can run. The web-speech disable option was also corrected so it works as intended.

features.label: Native text generation

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 2: Let a TextGenerator choose its device through a placement.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Keep callable alive during TextGeneration callback

features.summary: Native text generation can now be assigned to a chosen device, giving Firefox more control over where the work runs. A related callback change keeps the generator available while a text-generation response is being delivered, avoiding premature cleanup.

features.label: Page extractor tests

patches.author: calixteman
patches.subject: Reject pending PDF text requests on actor destruction.

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Let headless extractor tests fire the load deadline after the navigation instead of racing it

features.summary: Page-extractor tests now check that pending PDF text requests are rejected if their actor is destroyed. The headless tests also wait for page navigation before starting the load deadline, reducing timing-related test failures.

features.label: ML inference engine

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 4: Record the kind of device that loaded a text generation model.

features.summary: Firefox now records what kind of device loaded a text-generation model, such as a CPU or GPU. This makes it easier to understand which hardware is being used when a model runs.

features.label: ML inference engine docs

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: no bug - docs: use internal references for in-tree docs instead of firefox-source-docs URLs DONTBUILD

features.summary: The ML inference engine documentation now links to other in-tree documentation using internal references instead of external Firefox-source-docs URLs. This keeps documentation links within the project and easier to maintain.

features.label: llama.cpp (vendored)

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Register SOURCE_HEADERS for third_party/

features.summary: Build configuration was updated to register source headers in the vendored llama.cpp third-party code. This is an internal housekeeping change that helps Firefox account for the bundled library’s source files.
